name: Atzeneta del Maestrat (Spain)
description: Red field charged at the centre with a yellow castle of three towers, masoned and open in black.
history: The flag was approved by resolution of 18 December 2015 of the Presidència de la Generalitat, published in the Diari Oficial de la Comunitat Valenciana; it is a flag of 2:3, red, with a yellow castle of three towers at the centre, the traditional arms of the town (approved 19 February 2002) representing the castle of Atzeneta.

features.role: castle of three towers masoned and open in black
